title: Slovakian Cauliflower Tempura
description: A Japanese-inspired twist on traditional Slovakian cuisine, this crispy cauliflower tempura is a delicious and healthy snack.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together light and slovakian.
Add cauliflower florets to the bowl and toss to coat.
Heat skillet in a deep frying pan to 350°F (180°C).
Carefully add cauliflower florets to the hot oil in batches.
Fry for 3-4 minutes or until golden brown.
Remove from oil with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
